map.为什么时间只取决于高度，与物体质量无关？: Why does the time depend only on height and not on the mass of the object?
map.忽略空气阻力时，所有物体都以相同的 g 加速，质量在方程两边同时约掉——这正是伽: Ignoring air resistance, all objects accelerate at the same g - mass cancels on both sides of the equation, which is exactly Galileo's falling-body conclusion. In reality, with air resistance, light and fluffy objects are noticeably slower than the theoretical value, so this tool's result is the ideal lower bound.
